verdict.rationale: Granola documents a first-party Zapier integration connecting to 8,000+ apps to automate post-meeting work. Granola Chat can also draft and send Slack messages with a review step, so notes do reach Slack and thousands of apps. Notion is mentioned only as a use case you would build yourself with the Granola API, a developer building block rather than a native integration. Slack delivery is a manual, chat-driven message, not automatic posting of notes to channels. Missing for 10: native Notion page sync, automatic Slack channel posting of notes, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Zapier and Slack flows.
